fields.label: AI sets the time for new tasks
fields.description: When a task is created without a due date, the AI estimates the working days and hours from the task, the project type and how long similar tasks took.

fields.label: Write descriptions for new tasks with AI
fields.description: When a task is created without a description, the AI writes one in the background: the goal, the steps and when it is done. A description someone has typed is never replaced.

fields.label: Weekly Off
fields.options:
Sunday
Friday
Saturday and Sunday
Friday and Saturday
fields.description: Skipped when counting working days, and no follow-ups are sent on these days.

fields.label: Development Hours per Day
fields.description: Hours a developer spends on build work in a day; a customization estimate in hours becomes a delivery date with this.

fields.label: Saturdays Off
fields.description: When Saturday is a working day: which Saturdays of the month are off. They're skipped in task and estimate dates and added to every SLA's holiday list for the coming year.

fields.label: Email the customer when their support hours run low
fields.description: The customer's contacts get the same alerts as the team: once when a period reaches the contract's alert level and once when its hours are used up.
